purpose: Initial matched audition of the Two Marks, One Thread sonic mnemonic grammar.
fixedGrammar: Three-second sonic logo. At 0.00 one dry close mark; at 0.45 a second distant mark; from 0.55–1.75 one narrow pitched filament travels between them; at 1.75 contact reveals a compact warm interval; one fine upper resonance continues to the end. Intimate and restrained. No voice, crowd, drums, beat, anthem, notification, sci-fi whoosh or triumph.

decision.basis: Principal blind listen; Candidate A preferred. No rationale inferred.
decision.nextTest: Human/tactile structural refinements holding the material family constant.

candidates.label: A · Human / tactile
candidates.hypothesis: The connection feels made by hand and emotionally warm without becoming nostalgic.
candidates.material: Muted physical taps, a tensioned-string filament and warm woody, low-reed contact.
